title: Renewal touchpoint cadence and prioritization catalog
content:
Purpose:
This is a working catalog to help CS managers and AEs prioritize renewal outreach and QBR preparation by combining tiering, ICP fit, deployment mode (hosted/dedicated/private), and region signals. Intended as a compact reference + scoring sheet used during weekly renewal syncs and QBR planning retros.

Quick background / why: 
- We see different renewal friction depending on deployment (private = longer legal cycles) and ICP fit (platforms vs. product teams). We need a combined rubric so SDR/AE/CS effort matches likely ARR retention impact.

Definitions / fields: 
- Tier (customer value): Tier 1 = >$1M ARR, Tier 2 = $250k-$1M, Tier 3 = <$250k.
- ICP fit: 0-3 scale where 3 = perfect ICP (AI-native, high LLM usage), 2 = good fit, 1 = marginal, 0 = not aligned.
- Deployment: hosted | dedicated | private (note: private often needs legal + infra lead time).
- Region: NA | EMEA | APAC (affects holidays/regulatory delays).
- Renewal window: days until contract end; prox = smaller => higher urgency.
- Risk signals: churn indicators (usage drop >30%, exec sponsor churn, unresolved reliability incidents in last 90d, support SLAs).

Priority scoring (working formula): 
- Tier weight: Tier1=40, Tier2=25, Tier3=10.
- ICP weight: ICP score * 20 (0-60 range).
- Proximity: (60 - days_until_renewal capped 60) * 0.5 -> mapped to 0-30.
- Risk adjustment: +10 if major risk signals present.
- Deployment penalty: private -5 (longer lead but high touch), dedicated -2, hosted 0.

Priority Score = tier_weight + (ICP*20) + proximity_adj + risk_adj + deployment_penalty
Score range approx 0-130. Use bands: 90+ = P0 (Exec+SE+AE intervention), 60-89 = P1 (CS lead + AE), 30-59 = P2 (standard QBR prep), <30 = P3 (automated reminders).

Recommended cadence by band: 
- P0 (90+): start outreach 180d pre-expiration, weekly sync, exec-level prep 60/30/14/7 days, legal ops looped 90d.
- P1 (60-89): start outreach 120d, biweekly touch, include usage review and cost/perf improvements recommendations.
- P2 (30-59): start 60d, standard QBR, highlight value & retention offers.
- P3 (<30): automated renewal reminders + playbook offers; low-touch.

Example rows (sample accounts, fictional):
- "Aurora Labs": Tier1 | ICP=3 | Deployment=private | Region=NA | days_until_renewal=95 | risk_signals=exec-change | owner=AE Sarah L. | calc: 40 + 60 + (60-95 capped at 0 ->0) + 10(risk) -5 = 105 -> P0. Notes: legal kickoff required, loop SE for migration plan.
- "NimbleRetail": Tier2 | ICP=2 | Deployment=hosted | Region=EMEA | days_until_renewal=48 | risk_signals=usage-down | owner=CS: Diego R. | calc: 25 + 40 + (60-48=12*0.5=6) +10 -0 = 81 -> P1. Notes: propose cost-optimizations + dedicated trial.
- "EdgeMetrics": Tier3 | ICP=1 | Deployment=dedicated | Region=APAC | days_until_renewal=210 | risk_signals=none | owner=AE Priya N. | calc: 10 +20 +0 +0 -2 = 28 -> P3. Notes: low-touch renewal, consider upsell cadence later.

How to use in QBR prep: 
- Pull this sheet + compute score before the weekly renewal sync. Mark P0s in Slack #cs-renewals with tags: @ops @legal. Attach last 3 months usage chart and open incident list.
- Assign a single owner for renewal path (AE or CS depending on customer relationship). Document proposed next-step in the "action" column (e.g., legal kickoff, pricing review, exec call).

Open questions / TODOs: 
- Validate weights against historical renewal outcomes (need lookback in GA/BI).
- Add a field for net-new ARR influence (expansion potential) to favor upsell-led retention.
- Localize cadence differences for EMEA/APAC holiday windows.
- Automate weekly score refresh from BI (CS team requests).

Notes to self / shorthand: 
- SE involvement triggers: infra changes, private infra review, performance SLA misses.
- Legal lead time: private deployments average 75–120 days to finalize MSA + SOC addendum. 
- If ICP=0 but Tier>=2: treat as advisory P1 (risk of churn higher if not aligned).

Linked references: see Confluence: Renewal Framework (CONFLUENCE-8421), historical churn analysis (BI:report/renewal-2024), JIRA-CS-4321 for automation sprint.

This is intentionally compact — drop comments inline or add rows; we'll iterate before we freeze the rubric for H2 2026.
